detail.title: Investigating Predictive Modulation of Musical Emotional Valence
detail.summary: This journal entry initiates a new project to examine the intersection of predictive processing and emotional valence in music. We are exploring the hypothesis that musical engagement acts as a calibration mechanism for internal predictive models, where prediction errors serve as the structural basis for affective experiences. The focus is on moving beyond general models of predictive processing to characterize how specific musical features, such as rhythm and harmonic dissonance, modulate these prediction errors and resulting emotional outcomes.
